long_biography.plain_text:
Locke studied history and economics at Oxford before joining Citigroup in 1974, specialising in shipping and oil. He later established a Singapore business that financed and invested in shipping and offshore-service companies, then returned to Britain to found Abbot Group. The company grew into a global drilling, engineering and contracting enterprise.

After taking Abbot public and later leaving the group, Locke applied the same founder-investor model elsewhere. He established Motor Fuel Group in petrol-forecourt retail and helped launch Well-Safe Solutions for oil-well decommissioning, where he remains chairman and a major shareholder. He also chairs First Property Group and maintains interests in shipping, farming and spirits.
